code.description: JavaScript run in a sandbox. space.add({...}), space.patch(id, {...}), space.remove(ids), space.arrange({...}) take the same fields as apply ops; space.find(query) and space.layout helpers read the scene. Whatever the code returns comes back as result. Everything it writes is one batch.

request_id.description: An idempotency key chosen by the caller. A retry with the same key and the same payload returns the first result; with a different payload it is rejected (request_reused).

space_name.description: A Space's short, stable name, such as 'auth-plan'.
